handBoundary.rule: Every face incident to any positive hand/finger support, union both sides, then strict source-rest x half-space. Includes boundary faces and every legacy face; no weight cutoff. Source-driven scope, not anatomical truth.

method.hand: All three vertices each have >=.5 summed source hand/finger-joint weight for that side.
method.lowerBody: All three vertices each have >=.5 pelvis/thigh weight. This is a subset, not the whole body.
method.trousers: Lower source component after rounded rest-position bins at1e-7m,1712 faces.
method.predicate: AABB pruning and intersectTriangles at1e-10m; boundary contacts count. Selected witnesses also checked at1e-9/1e-11m.
method.limits: Discrete CPU-skinned geometry, triangle-pair counts only. No depth, continuous clearance, inside test, forearm coverage or visual-severity score.
